summary: The player fights the heart-shaped boss 'The Warden', firing two charged shots that break off two pods from the boss while dodging waves of pink bullets.

events.evidence: A cyan crescent wave is released from the player ship after the cannon bar fills to 1 pip, accompanied by a swoosh sound.
The cyan crescent hits the left side of the heart boss with a bright yellow ring impact and a metallic crunch sound.
A small piece detaches from the left side of the boss and tumbles away to the top-left.
The player ship moves from the left side toward the center-right to thread between pink bullet waves.
A second cyan crescent wave is fired upward from the player ship after charging 1 pip.
A cyan crescent hits the right side of the boss, producing a circular shockwave and impact sound.
A pod labeled 'RELIC' detaches from the boss and floats downward with a circular reticle around it.
The player releases another cyan crescent wave upward toward the boss.

readability_issues.issue: The bright cyan muzzle flash and charging aura around the player ship partially obscure nearby pink enemy bullets right next to the ship hitbox.
The detached relic part floating down has a bright circular indicator that looks very similar in size and color to the incoming pink/purple enemy bullets.
